text:
```yaml
name: Update Lint Config

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Runs every Monday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Download dependencies
        run: make deps

      - name: Run lint with local config
        run: make lint

      - name: Check for upstream changes
        id: check-upstream
        run: |
          curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/.golangci.yml > .golangci.yml.new
          if ! cmp --silent .golangci.yml .golangci.yml.new; then
            echo "::set-output name=has-changes::true"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=has-changes::false"
          fi

      - name: Create PR if changes detected
        if: ${{ steps.check-upstream.outputs.has-changes == 'true' }}
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add .golangci.yml
          git commit -m "chore: update lint config"
          git push origin HEAD:lint-config-update
          gh pr create --title "chore: update lint config" --body "This PR updates the lint configuration based on the latest upstream changes." --base main
```
